_note: Authored from a -DumpUia tree of the main window. Almost nothing in this app carries an AutomationId, so routes invoke by visible NAME — which means a copy change to a button silently breaks a route. Find-UiaElement matches Name OR AutomationId, so add ids and switch these over if routes start missing. Surfaces reachable only through a nested picker (library) or a non-Invoke control (tray menu, the Settings nav rail, the Tools menu) are captured in -Watch mode instead; they are listed in the checklist, not here.
_wave3: Glow wave 3 collapsed the main window's six nav buttons to Settings + a Tools menu, which deleted five routes from this file. About, History, Diagnostics, Games and Plugins are now MenuItems inside a popup, and a popup is NOT in the main window's automation subtree even while it is open — a driver walking down from the window root will never find them. They are -Watch captures now, listed in docs/ui-capture-checklist.md. The Settings route survives, but its invoke name changed: the button read '⚙ Settings' and now reads 'Settings' (F-012 dropped the glyph).
